header: The same week, three different jobs
lead: A duty manager, a payroll administrator and a shop assistant use Marlbrook Roster for different tasks. Each of them sees only their part.

panels.title: Duty managers
panels.text: Build the week, approve swaps and cover a sick call at seven in the morning from your phone. Costs update with every shift you move.

panels.title: Payroll and finance
panels.text: Close the month once, with corrections approved and premium rates applied. The export goes straight to payroll, and the audit trail is kept for seven years.

panels.title: Shop floor staff
panels.text: See next week as soon as it's published. Ask for a day off, offer a shift to a colleague or check this month's hours, without asking the office.
